<!--
You can use the following checklist when double-checking your CEP,
and you can help complete some of it yourself if you like
by ticking any boxes you're sure about, like this: [x]
If you're unsure about anything, just leave it blank and we'll take a look.

If your CEP is not Standards Track, remove the corresponding section.
-->

## Basic requirements (all CEP Types)

* [ ] Read and followed [CEP 1](https://cfms-dev.github.io/ceps/1) & [CEP 12](https://cfms-dev.github.io/ceps/12)
* [ ] File created from the [latest CEP template](https://github.com/cfms-dev/ceps/blob/main/ceps/cep-0012/cep-NNNN.rst?plain=1)
* [ ] CEP has next available number, & set in filename (``cep-NNNN.rst``), PR title (``CEP 123: <Title of CEP>``) and ``CEP`` header
* [ ] Title clearly, accurately and concisely describes the content in 79 characters or less
* [ ] Core dev/CEP editor listed as ``Author`` or ``Sponsor``, and formally confirmed their approval
* [ ] ``Author``, ``Status`` (``Draft``), ``Type`` and ``Created`` headers filled out correctly
* [ ] ``CEP-Delegate``, ``Topic``, ``Requires`` and ``Replaces`` headers completed if appropriate
* [ ] Required sections included
    * [ ] Abstract (first section)
    * [ ] Copyright (last section; exact wording from template required)
* [ ] Code is well-formatted and is in [code blocks, with the right lexer names](https://cfms-dev.github.io/ceps/cep-0012/#literal-blocks)
* [ ] CEP builds with no warnings, pre-commit checks pass and content displays as intended in the rendered HTML
* [ ] Authors/sponsor added to ``.github/CODEOWNERS`` for the CEP


## Standards Track requirements

* [ ] CEP topic [discussed in a suitable venue](https://cfms-dev.github.io/ceps/cep-0001/) with general agreement that a CEP is appropriate
* [ ] [Suggested sections](https://cfms-dev.github.io/ceps/cep-0012/#suggested-sections) included (unless not applicable)
    * [ ] Motivation
    * [ ] Specification
    * [ ] Rationale
    * [ ] Backwards Compatibility
    * [ ] Security Implications
    * [ ] How to Teach This
    * [ ] Reference Implementation
    * [ ] Rejected Ideas
    * [ ] Open Issues
    * [ ] Acknowledgements
    * [ ] Footnotes
    * [ ] Change History
* [ ] ``Protocol-Version`` set to valid target protocol version(s) (integer, comma-separated if multiple), if relevant
* [ ] Any project stated in the CEP as supporting/endorsing/benefiting from the CEP formally confirmed such
* [ ] Right before or after initial merging, [CEP discussion thread](https://cfms-dev.github.io/ceps/cep-0001/#discussing-a-cep) created and linked to in ``Discussions-To`` and ``Post-History``
